name: 1-play.jpg
shows: THE ECLIPSE mid-fight on wave 10 in the Lantern Observatory at golden hour. The boss is a big moon-faced creature screaming in its last phase (TOTALITY) under a Verdant corona crown, with its Shadow Ring creeping as ink across the honey marble. The robed Warden casts Verdant from his crystal lantern staff into it, while the Ember and Azure Prism branches bounce off brass standing mirrors and the walls into hooded shadow-imps of other colours. Boss, Warden and the brass orrery Core form a triangle with open floor between them. Cream-and-brass HUD: CORE with '0 = RUN LOST', 'WIN: break THE ECLIPSE after wave 10 · LOSE: the Core shatters', the boss phase bar, INCOMING with creature portraits, the event log, 'MATCH COLOUR', the build as icon cards and key caps. Chosen by tools/find-cover.mjs from 1,200 autopilot runs.
